Bring Your A-Game — AI Agent Idea

ReadyRepo

Your code is ready. Is your repo ready for AI?

1What would you like to call your AI agent?

ReadyRepo

2The problem

AI coding tools are becoming part of everyday development, but many repositories were built for people, not AI. The code may be there, but the context is not: architecture, build steps, testing expectations, coding standards and guardrails are often scattered or missing. That means developers spend time repeatedly explaining the repo, while AI tools make avoidable assumptions. This affects development teams across Aviva and limits the value we get from the AI tools we already use.

3The solution

ReadyRepo scans a repository and assesses how AI-ready it is. It identifies missing context, highlights gaps and generates a practical starter pack for review — for example repository instructions, architecture context, build/test guidance and security guardrails. The output is not auto-committed: developers review it first. The result is a clearer, more consistent way to prepare repositories for Copilot and future coding agents.

4What will your AI agent do?

✓ Receive information ✓ Understand and analyze information ✓ Generate content or recommendations ✓ Help make decisions or prioritize ○ Execute tasks in systems ○ Coordinate workflows and people ○ Interact with and support users ○ Monitor and support risk management ✓ Others
Other: Assess repository AI-readiness and identify missing context.
